name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The Fitness Enthusiast aims to meticulously track all their physical activities, including detailed metrics, to gain a complete overview of their performance and training load.
The Fitness Enthusiast seeks sophisticated tools for visualizing and analyzing their fitness progress over extended periods, identifying trends, and optimizing their training strategies.
The Fitness Enthusiast desires highly personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their evolving fitness level, specific goals, and performance data to maximize their training effectiveness.
The Beginner aims for a simple and intuitive way to log their physical activities, both automatically and manually, without being overwhelmed by complex features.
The Beginner seeks easy-to-understand visual representations of their fitness progress to stay motivated and see tangible results from their efforts.
The Beginner desires assistance in setting realistic and achievable fitness goals, along with clear tracking of their progress towards these goals, to maintain focus and build confidence.
The Wearable Device User aims for automatic and real-time synchronization of all fitness data from their wearable device to the application, ensuring accuracy and convenience.
The Wearable Device User desires a consolidated view of all their fitness metrics within the application, combining data from their wearable device with manually logged activities.
The Social Media User aims to easily share their fitness activities, achievements, and milestones on various social media platforms to celebrate their progress and inspire their network.
The Social Media User desires the ability to customize their shared posts with messages, images, and graphics to enhance engagement and personalize their fitness story on social media.
lowLevelGoals: The Fitness Enthusiast can initiate a new workout recording, selecting the activity type (e.g., running, cycling, weightlifting), inputting the duration, and specifying the perceived intensity level.
After an activity, the Fitness Enthusiast can input or review detailed metrics like distance covered, estimated calories burned, and time spent in different heart rate zones.
The Fitness Enthusiast can access a daily dashboard displaying a summary of all activities performed on that day, including total duration, total calories, and other aggregated metrics.

The Fitness Enthusiast can select a specific date range and generate a report that visualizes their performance trends for metrics like average pace, total distance, or strength gains over that period.
The Fitness Enthusiast can select a current activity or metric and compare it side-by-side with previous records to observe progress or identify areas needing adjustment.
The Fitness Enthusiast can view graphical representations of their progress towards defined goals, such as weight loss, strength increase, or endurance improvement, over time.
The system will present the Fitness Enthusiast with a suggested workout for the day, taking into account their last activities, current fitness level, and estimated recovery.
The Fitness Enthusiast can modify their personal fitness objectives within the application, and these changes will be used to tailor subsequent workout suggestions.
The Fitness Enthusiast can browse a curated collection of exercises and pre-designed workout routines that are appropriate for their current physical condition and align with their objectives.
The Beginner can easily select an activity like 'walking' or 'running' from a predefined list and enter simple information such as duration or distance.
The Beginner can press a 'start' button to begin tracking an activity and a 'stop' button to end it, with the system automatically recording the elapsed time.
The Beginner can access a straightforward screen that displays the number of activities they've completed and a general overview of their progress for the current week.
The Beginner can view a clear, graphical representation of their daily activities, such as a bar chart showing completed workouts and a simple counter for steps.
The Beginner can see a simple line graph that shows how their activity duration or frequency has changed over the past week, highlighting positive trends.

The system will display encouraging messages and award virtual badges to the Beginner when they reach predefined small goals, like completing their first workout or logging activities for three consecutive days.
The Beginner can choose a simple, achievable fitness goal from a curated list provided by the application.
The Beginner can view a visual element, such as a progress bar or a percentage complete, that clearly shows how close they are to achieving their chosen goal.
The system will send periodic notifications or display in-app messages to the Beginner, offering encouragement and practical advice to help them adhere to their goals.
The Wearable Device User can initiate a connection process within the application to link their specific wearable device, typically involving Bluetooth pairing or granting API access.
The Wearable Device User can set how often the application should pull data from their connected wearable device, choosing options like 'real-time', 'hourly', or 'daily'.
The Wearable Device User can press a 'sync now' button within the application to force an immediate transfer of the latest data from their wearable device.

The Wearable Device User can access a central dashboard that aggregates and displays all their fitness data, clearly indicating which data points originated from their wearable and which were manually entered.
The Wearable Device User can apply filters to their data view, allowing them to isolate and examine only the information collected by their wearable device or only their self-reported activities.
The application will highlight potential conflicts or inconsistencies between data sources, and the Wearable Device User can then choose which data to prioritize or edit.
The Social Media User can browse their past activities or achievements and select a specific one to share, initiating the sharing process.
After selecting an item to share, the Social Media User will be presented with options to post to various social media networks that are integrated with the application.
The application will automatically create a visually appealing image or a concise text summary of the chosen activity, ready for sharing.
Before finalizing the share, the Social Media User can type in their own personalized message or caption to accompany the activity details.
The Social Media User can choose from various visual templates or background images to make their shared activity post more engaging and aesthetically pleasing.
The Social Media User can easily add popular fitness hashtags or tag their friends in the post to increase visibility and interaction.
